game_concept: A action puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Bat Hollow, a hollow of roosting bats: the cave miner must handle glow-eyed lurkers while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Sentinel Loop: Keep serving visitors while the input is not 'quit' and stop on the sentinel word.
theme: Shadow Cave – Bat Hollow: a hollow of roosting bats
core_gameplay_loop: Solve the CP1 stations in the shared Canvas shell while the Week 4 game theme awaits course approval.
player_objective: Archive variation 5: classify and verify C history, characteristics and language categories for Portability.
controls: Read each archive record and choose the supported C fact.
win_condition: All researched archive facts are correctly identified.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 270, or lives reach 0.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
